answer: Make every verifier post a ferrous bond on-chain before countersigning transactions; any proof of an invalid signature triggers automatic slashing of that bond, sized well above a full epoch of rewards, so collusion never pays. The slashed stake is a costly, verifiable signal of honesty, and the fable that sybils can multiply income collapses: each fake identity must lock real collateral, making mass fake identities prohibitively expensive.
